result.markdown: --- gd-head-tags: - >- ``{=html} open-graph: title: >- [list_sdtm_domains()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-function} | Pointblank description: List the SDTM domains that have a template. twitter-card: title: >- [list_sdtm_domains()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-function} | Pointblank description: List the SDTM domains that have a template. title: >- [list_sdtm_domains()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-function} body-classes: doc-api-page doc-py-api-page shift-heading-level-by: 0 bread-crumbs: false toc-depth: 3 description-meta: List the SDTM domains that have a template. page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} List the SDTM domains that have a template. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/posit-dev/pointblank/blob/main/pointblank/metadata/_sdtm_templates.py#L1544-L1577){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-function} ```pythonsignature list_sdtm_domains() ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} These are the domain codes that [`get_sdtm_domain()`](`pointblank.get_sdtm_domain`), [`validate_sdtm()`](`pointblank.validate_sdtm`), [`validate_sdtm_structure()`](`pointblank.validate_sdtm_structure`) and [`sdtm_to_metadata()`](`pointblank.sdtm_to_metadata`) accept. ::: ## Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [list[str]]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : The domain codes, in alphabetical order. ::: ## Examples {.doc-examples} Let's list the domains, together with the label and class of each one's template: ::: {#f6b09017 .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import pointblank as pb for code in pb.list_sdtm_domains(): template = pb.get_sdtm_domain(code) print(f"{code} {template.label:26}{template.domain_class}") ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` AE Adverse Events Events CM Concomitant Medications Interventions DM Demographics Special Purpose DS Disposition Events EX Exposure Interventions LB Laboratory Test Results Findings MH Medical History Events VS Vital Signs Findings ``` ::: ::: The eight domains come from all four of the observation classes that the templates use: Special Purpose (DM), Events, Interventions and Findings. ## See Also {.doc-see-also} [](`~get_sdtm_domain`) : Get the template for a domain. [](`~list_adam_datasets`) : The equivalent for ADaM datasets.
